topics.topic: A09 request-construction rules for atypical HTTP methods and inputs (path-bound fields and file inputs/body encoding)
questions: For non-GET/DELETE methods, does the JSON body include path-bound input ports as well, or only non-path inputs?
If a binding uses a method outside POST/PUT/PATCH and has a `file` input, is proposal/refusal behavior defined, and what body encoding must be used?

topics.topic: Kernel behavior when sandbox execution is unavailable, including action handling, startup recovery, and run-advancement scope
questions: For actions that imply multiple executions or side effects (submit implementation/admission, run flow with function nodes, startup recovery), is the whole action refused before creating/changing records, or does it proceed and record execution failures?
If the kernel restarts with unresolved `running` runs but sandbox execution is unavailable, must startup recovery block startup, skip recovery, or mark affected runs to a terminal/waiting state?
Does this block only function executions (try/admission/function nodes) or all run advancement including service-only flows?

topics.topic: Outcome/status mapping for malformed, non-final, or protocol-invalid HTTP responses
questions: How should malformed HTTP responses or protocol violations after request bytes are sent be classified (`service_unreachable`, `operation_failed`, or `outcome_unknown`)?
How are 1xx or otherwise non-final/non-covered status cases mapped to NodeExecution and (for non-read) EffectAttempt status?

topics.topic: Scheduler policy for mapped nodes: finish same node’s runnable elements vs global interleaving/reselection
questions: When other nodes are ready, must the kernel finish all runnable elements of the smallest-id mapped node before switching, or may it interleave nodes between elements?
After one mapped element concludes (or waits), must execution continue with the same node’s next element immediately, or reselect the next ready node globally by `node_id` each step?

topics.topic: Whether pre-send operation failures consume/increment NodeExecution `attempt_number`
questions: When pre-send checks fail before send, does NodeExecution consume/increment `attempt_number`, and if yes how is it related to missing EffectAttempt?
When an operation fails before send (binding stale/invalid target/input placement), does that NodeExecution consume an `attempt_number`, and if so by what rule?

topics.topic: Agent-visible projection of `personal_data` fields (include `value_id` or only digest/class)
questions: For personal_data returned to an agent, is `value_id` part of the allowed projection or must responses contain only digest and class?

topics.topic: Authorization matrix for owner vs agent on propose binding, compose/prove flow, and try implementation
questions: Is the owner allowed to propose bindings, compose/prove flows, and try implementations, or are these agent-only actions?

topics.topic: Behavior when requested pagination size exceeds `page_size_max` (clamp vs reject)
questions: If a caller requests a page size greater than `page_size_max`, does the kernel clamp to `page_size_max` or refuse the request?

topics.topic: Check ordering for activate-flow: authorization before proof or after proof
questions: For activate-flow, is authorization checked before proof (global order) or after proof (A06-specific order)?

topics.topic: Classification/detail codes for malformed or ambiguous manifest reads (manifest-mismatch refusal vs internal error)
questions: Are malformed/ambiguous manifest records treated as `manifest mismatch` refusals or internal errors, and which detail codes are required?

topics.topic: Continuation-token semantics for pagination (stable snapshot vs live cursor, and duplicate/skip guarantees)
questions: What exact continuation-token semantics are required (stable snapshot vs live cursor), and are duplicates/skips across concurrent new records allowed?

topics.topic: Enforcement of `many` port runtime shape as list values and corresponding failure behavior
questions: Must runtime/proof enforce that values on `many` ports are lists regardless of schema, and what failure is emitted when not?

topics.topic: Recorded outcome precedence when trap and timeout/resource-exhaustion both occur
questions: If a trap occurs and later timeout/resource exhaustion also occurs, which outcome must be recorded?

topics.topic: Validation rules for named case lists in `try implementation` (unknown, duplicate, or out-of-corpus case ids)
questions: How must the kernel handle named case lists that include unknown case ids, duplicate ids, or ids outside the implementation's contract version corpus?

topics.topic: Whether `skipped_by_guard`/`upstream_failed` executions are inside the normal per-element attempt-number sequence
questions: Are `skipped_by_guard`/`upstream_failed` records outside the attempt sequence (with a fixed sentinel `attempt_number=1`), or do they participate in the same per-element attempt counter rules?

topics.topic: Whether multiple edges that can deliver to the same `many` input are allowed or must be refused
questions: Should two edges that can both deliver into the same `many` input be allowed or always refused?
